headline.line: The study presents a reproducible computational workflow that combines morphometric descriptors from MomePy-based tessellations with Foursquare-derived activity indexes.

synthesis.paragraph: In today's research, "Estimating and mapping Tokyo Window View Desirability" shares 9 references with the June 13 paper "City landscape in sight," including "View Through a Window May Influence Recovery from Surgery," "How we evaluate the view out through the window," and "Evaluation of the effect of landscape distance seen in window views on visual satisfaction." Additionally, "Shaping socio-functional urban identity" shares 5 references with the June 24 paper "Are urban form and function related to urban discourse?", with shared citations including "User-Generated Big Data and Urban Morphology," "Measuring urban vibrancy of neighborhood performance using social media data in Oslo, Norway," and "Spatial Signatures." Finally, "Redefining empty trips through occupancy and transferability of cross-modal strategies" shares 3 references with the June 18 paper "User centric multimodal urban transportation network equilibrium," including "A unified equilibrium framework of new shared mobility systems," "Can sharing a ride make for less traffic?", and "Ride-Sourcing modeling and pricing in non-equilibrium two-sided markets." Among the contributing institutions, Delft University of Technology appears on 3 papers, while the University of Cambridge and Osaka Metropolitan University each appear on 2 papers.
